method.what: what the Vial maps need to play a Long as loud as SSO's matching patch at every written dynamic under Recommended (realRange 2, sectionBalance 2): the SSO instrument's realSteps / realSpan / realPlay, sectionLevel(2) = SSO's + offsetDb, long = SSO's longLevel + Vial - SSO at that CC1 and pitch + offsetDb
method.offset: mean over SSO's measured pitches of SSO Long - Vial preset at CC1 64, loudDb (the section balance's measure, section_balance_cl.py at64)
method.error: per marking: mean / SD / min / max over the pitches of heard_vial - heard_sso (heard = measured level at the marking's CC1 + realDb + sectionLevel2), per measure; phon from sones (ISO 532-1)
method.sources: vial_cc1_curves.json; sso_cc1_curves.json, sso_winds_cc1_curves.json; the SSO map
